cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Can You Keep It?
cards.instruction: Use increasingly sensitive details to test whether someone deserves deeper trust.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The club's changing the menu. Keep that quiet before I tell you the bigger news.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Not even the person you tell everything to?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We've found the first lock to check.
